instructions.description: Start a parallel child script with an explicit kind and the same script base. Its entry is relative to the next instruction; register its task handle.
Start a parallel child script as in 00, with kind 128. This is not a stack-based call/return.
Remove the current task from the registered handles, clear its owner at context +8, and terminate this script task.
Set the child-script filter at +7 and wait while a matching registered task exists. Kind 255 matches any task; this does not select an actor.
Wait until all registered child-script tasks have finished by using filter 255.
Release tasks in the 16 registered handle slots and clear the slots. This does not remove map actors.
Skip when the global scene-state halfword is 3; otherwise start a brightness task. Its factory uses high(b1)-low(b1), b2, and b3.
Start the mode-1 branch of the brightness factory with a null command pointer. Its exact restore/default result depends on the downstream callback.
Write 00, 03, 10, 00 to display-shadow offsets +4a through +4d, configuring blending, then yield until the next scheduling pass.
Clear the BLDCNT and BLDALPHA display-shadow fields, then yield until the next scheduling pass.
Resolve an actor and invoke the same callback on its child objects at +54 and +58 with value. The final visual meaning remains unresolved.
Create a two-channel alpha-blending interpolation task. Callback 081269e4 updates both BLDALPHA bytes and notifies the owner when complete.
Use the current 40-byte content record's map when b1 is zero, otherwise use b1. Write save byte 7, set global scene state to 10, and wait for state 14.
Set the global scene-state byte to 12 and wait for the outer controller to reach 14.
Set display-shadow bits 0x0300 when enabled is nonzero, or clear them otherwise; background-layer visibility control.
Create a 180-byte native dialogue event task. The native callback consumes its text selector, speaker, and presentation flags.
Write a halfword at content-state address 020020d0+a4. Its specific mission role is not assigned a general name.
Start the 180-byte message/prompt event whose callback is 08125de8. The final text-selection contract remains unresolved.
If b1 has its high bit set, use mode 1 and b1-128; otherwise use mode 2 and b1. Start the 08125fa8 prompt/dialogue task, not a generic scene-mode bit write.
Start the 180-byte context event with callback 08126118 and clear the owner's completion flag. Its final interaction contract remains unresolved.
Return asynchronous-completion wait status without starting an action. Unused in retail scripts; it can hang without a completion producer.
Set the context +4 frame countdown from an unsigned byte and wait. Zero resumes after the next state polling pass.
Set the context +4 frame countdown from an unsigned halfword and wait, as in 15.
Write the scene-control byte in the global root. Modes 4 and 8 invoke additional transitions; then terminate the current script.
Write the transition state at +6. Remap 3 to 1, 6 to 3, and 7 to 5; modes 9/10/11/14 have dedicated workflows. Other paths enter the transition state machine.
Add a 16-bit displacement to PC; the dispatcher then adds the instruction length of 3. The resulting branch is relative to the next instruction.
Set or clear a native bit flag through 080c9574. The actual bitfield covers IDs 0-1535; the handler does not allocate safe custom flags.
Write the save byte at RAM 02002030+index through 080c95c0. This is separate from the bit flags used by 1a; unused in retail scripts.
Append a halfword scene ID to the queue at 02002194 and increment its count at 0200219c. The handler does not check queue capacity.
Write the same byte to 02002190 and 02002191. These belong to outer scene state and are not general custom variables.
Resolve b1 through 08036330, write 02001f69, clear 02003c2b, and apply through 08036584. The selector's final domain remains unresolved.
Split two packed coordinate pairs and forward them with the other parameters to scene-placement factory 081242a0. Template identity and lifecycle depend on that factory.
Forward the low/high coordinate nibbles, facing, and the low flags nibble to actor-configuration helper 08124480. The opening uses a verified placement subset.
Apply a selector/value pair through 08124560. The final field and mode meanings remain unresolved.
Call 08124648 for selector zero, otherwise 08125624, then enter countdown wait. The existing +4 value may matter; the final selection contract remains unresolved.
Clear bit 0 of the resolved actor object's flags through 08125760 and preserve other bits; yield until the next scheduling pass.
Set bit 0 of the resolved actor object's flags through 08125760 and preserve other bits; yield until the next scheduling pass.
Create a native asynchronous facing action through 08126dfc and callback 08126bfc, notifying the owner on completion. This differs from direct field write 29.
Create a two-actor action through 08126e34 with owner, first, second, first. Its exact action/following modes remain unresolved.
Create a unit action task through 08126ea4 and callback 08126d34. An action argument is not automatically a graphics-animation resource ID.
Read the resolved actor's unit byte +f8 and reapply kind-1 state through 08124710. The opening uses this to refresh facing.
Write actor byte +1f directly. It does not independently refresh or wait; the opening pairs it with 28.
Restore current HP and MP from their maximum values, clear several status ranges, reset actor flags, and refresh through 08124d58. This is not arbitrary HP assignment.
Start actor palette-override callback 0812682c. The script continues immediately; conditions including 100 have original-palette restoration paths.
Start the 72-byte task whose callback is 08126910 without waiting in the main script. Its final presentation semantics remain unresolved.
Apply a unit-state write through 080cd884. When stateIndex is zero, additionally clear current HP at +18 and current MP at +1c.
Add three 16-bit values to actor fields +08, +0c, and +0a with 16-bit wraparound. This is not a direct grid-tile assignment.
Update unit grid coordinates and actor position. Coordinate 255 preserves the corresponding current world axis shifted right by 5; update unit f6/f7 and f9/fa.
Mode 0 controls actor-flags bit 2. Mode 1 updates bits 0x1000/0x4000 according to value and invokes a refresh helper; their final meanings remain unresolved.
Clear actor attachments, multiply the argument by 4 and truncate to u16 for action update, refresh presentation, and set actor-flags bit 0x100.
Read the unit's native palette/slot value and update actor byte +1e. This does not create a unit.
Instantiate a scene actor from a type, reference unit, and three candidate tiles. Helper 08125444 chooses the first vacant tile and computes facing; this does not prove combat-turn registration.
For selectors 254/255, scan eligible primary units and set flags 0x400. Otherwise select from the 12 encounter slots and write saved selection slot 0, 1, or 2.
Bind a native unit handle from saved selection slot 0/1/2 using a one-based index. An empty selection can underflow; this is not an unchecked general binding API.
Set transition state +6 to 7 and +4 to selector, then enter the mission reward/unit-result workflow. This is not an ordinary conditional branch.
Resolve a native unit and set bit 0x100 in its +28 flags halfword when present.
Pack selector, signed 16-bit value, mode, and amount for 08127c54. The final height/action meaning remains unresolved.
Pack two words containing actor, signed deltas, mode, and argument for 08127b80. Opcode 3a uses the same path after computing deltas from target tiles.
Compute target-tile-center deltas through 08124e74; a negative coordinate produces zero delta for that axis. Create the action through 08127b80.
The retail handler only returns 110. This eight-byte instruction is a no-op and is unused by retail programs.
The retail handler only returns 110. This six-byte instruction is a no-op and is unused by retail programs.
Use signed deltas directly with the movement factories shared by 3e. Dispatch 1 calls 08127c10; other values call 08127bc4.
Compute target-tile deltas, write mode to payload byte 1 and argument to payload +6, then select 08127c10/08127bc4. Retail assembly confirms +6; one partial C recovery incorrectly writes +2.
For distinct packed coordinates sharing an x or y coordinate, unpack both nibble pairs and invoke straight-line helper 08124974.
Read the start tile from the actor's unit f6/f7 and invoke 08124974 only when the target shares its row or column.
Use low(b2) as a path slot and bits 4-6 as the repetition parameter for 08127af8. Bit 7 does not enter that parameter.
Create a path request through 08127af8 with repetitions high-low+1, narrowed to a byte. A reversed range is not checked for safety.
Merge two cached paths by removing the last point of the first and appending the whole second. Source slots are the low/high nibbles; the destination cache holds only 32 points.
Create coordinate-path task 08127b40 with delay from the low nibble and tail from the high nibble of b4. Byte b3 is unused.
Load a coordinate path from the relative directory at A19D18 into a cache slot, adding terrain height and clearing entry flags. This does not append new path assets.
Project an actor's tile position and terrain height into a camera target. Modes 1/2/0 use interpolation; mode 0 indexes a speed table and mode 3 starts 08128898.
Move the camera to signed coordinates. Mode 1 with amount zero sets immediately; modes 1/2 compute countdowns, mode 0 indexes a table, and mode 3 creates a task.
Execute scene selector 08123e00. If native save byte 13 equals 1, return wait status 119. This reads a byte, not story bit flag 13.
For nonzero restore, release/restore scene resources and compact the roster when pending bit 8 is set. Zero ensures a restore actor exists; this is not a generic scene end.
Apply the current content index to its context through 08096e18; related to mission/deployment selection.
Select an audio/presentation preset. Value 255 reads current content-record byte +26, with a special global-state path using save byte 20. Apply the selector and yield.
Apply native audio-definition service 08141570. Modes 255/2/4 prepare selected volume bytes at 100 and map to service channels 1/2; clear the countdown and wait one scheduling pass.
Replicate level into selected byte channels and start volume interpolation through 0812800c. Downstream calls reach floating-point volume setters; mask bit 3 is not a verified fourth audio track.
Populate units from explicit unit/placement banks when available, otherwise from current content. Native save byte 13 equal to 1 selects wait state 11a.
For nonzero update, refresh selected unit actions; otherwise filter actors for transition. This does not register a newly spawned combatant.
Start a context action through 081286dc. Its exact control/input-feedback semantics remain unresolved.
Call 0809a260(context, 0) and then 080a9548. This is not established as a generic mission-completion instruction.
Clear story-unit state, commit unit-property and occupancy flags, and refresh values for the 24 primary units.
Search the 12-byte records at 563a70 in descending order for identifier, write selected record 3c2a, and select its content. Identifier is not a direct unit-bank address.
Apply value through 080bd11c and write native save byte 53. The final system-property domain remains unresolved.
Pass four bytes to graphics/map helper 0801ddb4. Its final visual effect remains unresolved.
Call 0801de20 with constant 3. The final effect remains unresolved.
Start task-context initialization through 080d376c and wait for 080d37f8.
Start task-state clearing through 080d37ac and wait for 080d37c4.
Resolve an actor and store it in the current-entity global slot. This does not create a unit binding.
Pass b1-1, narrowed to u16, to 08124fd0. Input zero becomes 65535; this is not a safe unchecked general index.
If 080d3878 reports completion, release and clear the task context. Otherwise enter polling/cleanup wait state 118.
Queue dedicated action B0 with a halfword through 0812b7d0. Its final mission/UI contract remains unresolved.
Write content-state bytes 020020d0+a6/a7. These are not custom variables.
Queue dedicated action 44 through 0812bd2c. Its final UI workflow remains unresolved.
Queue dedicated action 44 with a byte through 0812bce4. Its final UI workflow remains unresolved.
Queue dedicated action 08 through 0812bd0c. This is not a general key-reading instruction.
When native save byte 13 is 1, clear it, set a 16-frame countdown and content flag 40, then wait and invoke 08004c40. Otherwise continue immediately.
Create dedicated action 108 through 0812c4e4. A nonzero wait byte waits for completion; zero lets the script continue. The remaining payload contract is unresolved.
Reset scene-view state through 08125938, then wait according to the current +4 countdown. The exact visual reset scope remains unresolved.
Branch when the selected unit exists and predicates 080c8260 and 080c8240 both return zero.
Branch when the indexed native story bit flag is nonzero. High-level when uses this instruction.
Branch when a unit exists and the requested bit of its +28 flags halfword is set. The safe bit range is 0-15.
Branch when RAM byte 020021b4 is strictly greater than threshold, not less than threshold.
Resolve the current saved selector through 08036350. Nonzero b1 requires equality; b1 zero accepts resolved slots 1-6.
Branch when bit 0 is set in the current 563a70 definition record's flags at +8.
Branch when bit 1 is clear in the current definition record's flags; its polarity differs from 69.
Return 110 with no side effects. This no-op is unused in retail programs.
Branch when a unit exists and exclusion predicates 080c8348, 080cd92c, 080cd95c, 080cd9a4, and 080cd9bc all return zero.
Branch when byte +22 of the current 40-byte content record is zero.
Branch when native save byte 13 equals exactly 1, not when story bit flag 13 is set.
For an active unit passing two exclusion checks, branch when current HP exceeds threshold. Thresholds 0-9 are absolute; larger values compare against floor(maxHP*threshold/100), strictly greater.
Scan current scene units, excluding specified states and property-1 values 94/10/9/4/12. Branch only when no eligible unit remains; this is not simply all enemy HP equal to zero.
Read native menu result SaveByte19. Branch for low byte zero; the second choice and B cancellation (255) continue sequentially. Native menu branching already exists.
